rows.text: returns at once when bits 2-17 of dword `[rcx]` are zero; otherwise walks the qword pointer array at qword `rcx+0x10` (stride 8) for `(dword [rcx] >> 2) AND 0xFFFF` entries, re-read each pass, and for each entry takes the kind `(dword +8 >> 2) AND 0xF`: kinds 2, 5 and 9 copy words `+4` and `+6` of the qword `[entry]` record into the entry's words `+0xC` and `+0xE`; kind 8 copies the same two words into words `+0x98` and `+0x9A` of qword `entry+0x18` when that is non-null; other kinds write nothing

looks up the words `[rcx]` and `[rdx]` as `0035D330(1, word << 0x10)` and returns the difference of the two records' dwords `+0x38` (first minus second) when it is non-zero; otherwise looks both up again and returns the difference of their dwords `+0x30` when non-zero, else the difference of the two zero-extended words
